definitions.explanation: The small circle written at the upper right of a kana in the は row to show a p sound: は becomes ぱ, ひ becomes ぴ, and so on.

examples.japanese: {半濁点|はんだくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける。

examples.english: Adding a handakuten to は gives ぱ.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{濁点|だくてん}→濁点：27818_dakuten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{半濁点|はんだくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える→書き間違える：21977_kakimachigaeru⟧。
examples.english: Children often mix up the dakuten and the handakuten.

notes:
Also called ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ informally ("put a circle on it"). Only the five ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧-row kana take it: ぱ ぴ ぷ ぺ ぽ (パ ピ プ ペ ポ in katakana); the sounds they write are ⟦{半濁音|はんだくおん}→半濁音：23453_handakuon⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{濁点|だくてん}→濁点：27818_dakuten⟧: dakuten, the two-stroke mark ゛ for voiced sounds (が, ば) — popularly てんてん
- ⟦{半濁音|はんだくおん}→半濁音：23453_handakuon⟧: the p sounds themselves
